main_text.l: Ex quo tria statim edisci tis. Primum
est, quod Physica dici debet Scientia. Pro-
taph. c. 1. dividit scientiam in Physicam,
cundo etiam ratione, quia Physica est
cognitio certa, & evidens rei per cau-
sam; ergo scientia dicenda est. Patet ante-
cedens, nam illa cognoscit v. g. mixtum
contrariis: terram esse in infimo loco,
quia inter elementa maximè gravis est
&c. ergo Physica manet cognitio certa, & evidens

page.notes: Woodcut initial "A" at the start of the first paragraph. The top line of the title is a large decorated "PRIMA PARS". Page-end word "scientia" is split as "scien-tia." Some words in the lower lines are partly obscured by ink and show-through; "edisci tis" and "evidens" readings are doubtful. Printed as "Graeco nomine Physis" in the scan. Header ornament and the faint digitiser watermark at bottom right are omitted.
